description: Every tool call produces a structurally complete ToolCallRecord with non-empty id, delegation_packet_id, agent_id, task_type, tool_name, valid JSON input_params_json, output_summary ≤ 500 tokens, duration_ms ≥ 0, boolean success, valid ISO-8601 timestamp, and sequence_position ≥ 1

preconditions.description: A tool execution completes (success or failure) within a DelegationPacket context

expectedOutcome.description: A ToolCallRecord is created with all required fields populated and valid, then sent to the mpsc channel for buffered persistence

verificationMethod.testName: Property 1: Tool Call Record structural completeness
